synthesizedFacts.fact: Microneedling can temporarily make skin appear more wrinkled due to transepidermal water loss (TEWL) and dehydration.
The initial worsening of skin appearance after microneedling is part of the normal healing process, involving inflammation, proliferation, and remodeling phases.
Proper aftercare is crucial to mitigate the temporary negative effects of microneedling and to support skin recovery.
